subject: science
skillName: Speed and the Energy of Motion

items.prompt:
A moving object has
A) no energy
B) energy of motion
C) only color
D) weight but no energy

steps: Moving objects have energy of motion.

items.prompt:
Which has more energy of motion?
A) A slow ball
B) A fast ball of the same size
C) Both are equal
D) Neither has energy
items.answer: B) A fast ball of the same size

steps: More speed means more energy of motion.

items.prompt:
A fast bowling ball knocks over more pins than a slow one. This shows
A) faster objects have more energy
B) slow objects have more energy
C) speed does not matter
D) pins have energy
items.answer: A) faster objects have more energy

steps: Knocking over more pins shows more energy.

items.prompt:
To make a ball push a target farther, roll it
A) slower
B) faster
C) it makes no difference
D) backwards

steps: A faster ball carries more energy to move the target.

items.prompt:
A faster river can carry bigger rocks because it has
A) less energy
B) more energy of motion
C) colder water
D) more fish

steps: Faster water has more energy to move larger rocks.

items.prompt:
Two identical cars hit a block. Car A moves it far, Car B barely moves it. Which was faster?
A) Car A
B) Car B
C) They were the same speed
D) Cannot tell at all

steps: Moving the block farther shows Car A had more energy and was faster.

items.prompt:
The BEST evidence that a faster marble has more energy is that it
A) is the same color
B) moves a target farther when it hits
C) is round
D) is heavier
items.answer: B) moves a target farther when it hits

steps: Moving the target farther shows more energy was transferred.

items.prompt:
A student says a slow and fast ball of the same size have equal energy. This is
A) correct
B) wrong, because the faster ball has more energy
C) wrong, because the slow ball has more energy
D) impossible to judge
items.answer: B) wrong, because the faster ball has more energy

steps: For the same object, more speed means more energy.
